fusions.name: Lifted Arrow
fusions.desc: Fires an arrow that deals 8 damage to the first enemy it meets, with 25% more critical chance against an enemy that has not been hurt yet. It holds 4 charges, and each kill hands one back.

fusions.name: Branch Volley
fusions.desc: Looses 3 arrows at once, spread apart, each dealing 8 damage and knocking its target back 2 tiles. You move 20% faster for 3 seconds after using it.

fusions.name: High Perch
fusions.desc: For 15 seconds, your attacks and spells reach 43% further.

fusions.name: Snap Shot
fusions.desc: Every few paces you cover, your critical chance rises by 25% for your next strike. Once every 6 seconds.
